verdict.rationale: Poly can be driven programmatically through a documented, live hosted MCP server at https://mcp.poly.app/mcp, which uses OAuth and exposes search, fetch and a virtual `poly` CLI as tools. It also has a scriptable `poly` CLI with an agent skill for search, read, create, update and organize. However, no general-purpose public API is documented: all OpenAPI/Swagger probes returned 404 and the docs never describe a REST/HTTP API. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose public REST/HTTP API with an OpenAPI spec, endpoint reference docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven use.
